description.value: Pokey Okey is a Vancouver-born poke bowl chain that opened in Richmond in 2018 and has since expanded to three locations, including this downtown Hornby Street spot. Every bowl is built with fresh fish sourced responsibly and locally grown vegetables, using traditional Hawaiian poke technique with a Pacific Northwest twist. It makes for a fast, nutritious, and customizable meal stop in the heart of downtown Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is reachable and confirms this is a real, operating poke bowl restaurant at 995 Hornby St, Downtown Vancouver, with pickup ordering available. The website consistently uses the brand name 'Pokey Okey' rather than the OSM name 'Poke Okey', and the footer email domain (pokeyokey.com) corroborates the website spelling. Phone number matches between OSM and website; no bike parking or washroom details appear on the website.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Poke Okey' but the business's own website, domain (pokeyokey.com), and contact email (hello@pokeyokey.com) consistently use 'Pokey Okey'. The OSM name may be a misspelling.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active fast-food poke bowl restaurant with a confirmed website, matching address, and active ordering. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists in downtown Vancouver.

wow_evidence: Vancouver-born poke bowl chain... expanded to three locations
